## Current verification and review readiness — 2026-11-23

This bounded protocol recovery and stale-build-authority repair is **Ready for review** at `13730fabc31c1fbc2a00798eeefde07911b672b2`. This continuation independently re-ran the original Python suites (**9 + 7 = 16/16**, no skips), checked all four source hashes against the prior independent review, and repeated the public-document check (**305 bilingual routes / 435 maintained documents / zero errors**). The real dispatch controls still reject observation before server creation after all five recorded failed rebuild transitions and accept observation only after a subsequent full success.

- [x] **Recover the four original protocol source files and preserve their provenance.**
- [x] **Revoke stale build authority on every attempted rebuild and retain the original failing controls.**
- [x] **Re-execute all 16 offline protocol controls on the published source.**
- [x] **Public-document validation and exact reviewed-source hash comparison.**
- [x] **Native DCO and live Ready state verified for this head.**
- [ ] Formal independent GitHub approval and integration remain pending.

Actual model/API/browser/install/consumer/participant runs still equal **0**; the frozen-stage and original experimental acceptance conditions remain open in #750/#734. The Vercel failure is the recorded daily-deployment quota; it remains visible and has not been relabeled. Full scheduled execution jobs were skipped by the existing PR policy and are not counted as passing. First missing-dependency setup failures were retained before the successful fixed-toolchain rerun.

Agent: ChatGPT Codex, acting on the current user's request to finish the drafts. The original body and all its acceptance boundaries are preserved below.

<summary>Preserved earlier Draft record</summary>

## Why

The original Sprint 7 worktree held four uncommitted experimental protocol files. Their build/observe state machine also retained an earlier successful build after a failed rebuild at the same revision. This PR preserves the source and repairs that demonstrated defect under the user's existing Sprint continuation.

This relates to #750 and #734. Their existing experiment scope, release deferral and acceptance criteria remain unchanged.

## Changes

1. **Original-source checkpoint `69bf36be7237d34e8c387c8422b039ea37677003`:** recover four files / 35,356 unchanged source bytes, their provenance, 15 original offline controls, independent review and actual documentation-check receipts. These files were previously uncommitted; no original commit or author is invented.
2. **Repair `13730fabc31c1fbc2a00798eeefde07911b672b2`:** clear `built_revision` when a legal rebuild starts, before typecheck or bundler work. Only the existing complete-success path restores observation authority. The original fixed commands, file capabilities, finish semantics and provider transport are unchanged.

Both commits are additive on main `38afc8942bfd245e12eaa661298c2feddbc63af8`. The original checkpoint records remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

## Actual regression and verification

| Evidence | Actual result |
| --- | --- |
| Same new test against the original broker Git blob | **Exit 1, five failed subcases:** stale observer path reached after typecheck failure/timeout, bundler failure/timeout, or a deadline exception |
| Repaired offline controls | **9 + 7 = 16 passed**, 0 skips |
| Independent rerun and source review | **16 passed**, exact source/Git blobs matched; PROTOCOL-BUILD-001 closed for the reviewed source |
| Public documentation check | **305 bilingual routes, 435 maintained documents, 0 errors** |
| Published Git readback | Exact tested source, parent/tree and original-record preservation verified; isolated worktree clean |

Full receipts, the lossless original failure log and independent sidecars are in [the repair record](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/tree/13730fabc31c1fbc2a00798eeefde07911b672b2/internal/records/evidence/2026-11-22-sprint7-protocol-build-revision). The [original checkpoint](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/tree/69bf36be7237d34e8c387c8422b039ea37677003/internal/records/evidence/2026-11-22-sprint7-protocol-checkpoint) retains the prior state and checks.

The new test invokes the real dispatch state machine with command, server and thread test doubles. It rejects observe **before server creation** after each failure, then verifies that a subsequent complete success restores the observer path.

## Remaining execution work

Actual **model / API / browser / install / consumer-build / consumer-observation / participant runs remain 0**. The four-file import closure supports these offline tests. A live consumer run still needs a separately frozen and reviewed task, starter, genuine distribution, dependency lock, runtime and stage-local builder/observer scripts.

Finish/exit-0 semantics and provider authentication remain unverified. These controls do not establish a complete sandbox, all artifact freshness properties, full experimental result, consumer admission or comparative advantage. The other 17 experimental scripts and knowledge-consumer/Dialog calibration changes remain outside this restoration.

Implemented with Codex. This Draft PR records source and evidence review; no merge, deployment, formal GitHub approval, experiment acceptance or issue closure is claimed.
